citations.claim: body overlaps wall by 0.34 exceeding 0.15 limit

counterfactual.change: Reduced vx magnitude from -48.73 to -10 (single field) – lower speed allows substep collision detection to resolve wall correctly

explanation: High-speed body moving left into wall tunnels through: semi-implicit Euler with substeps fails to detect/correct collision when velocity is extreme (~49 m/s) with dt 0.022, causing position to end inside wall exceeding penetration tolerance.
vision_note: In step 0 the red circular body sits just to the right of the dark grey rectangular wall with a visible gap. In step 1 it has shifted left and is now overlapping and embedded in the wall's lower right corner, exceeding the allowed penetration tolerance.
